appliedUpdates.description: Updated architecture.md listing pages pattern: changed 'Cards are rendered inline in the client component (not as separate feature components)' to 'Cards are defined in the same file as the listing page client component, either inline or as extracted function components' to reflect the actual pattern used after context menu extraction.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention: Workers should not bundle .factory/ scaffolding files (init.sh, library/*.md, services.yaml, settings.json, skills/) into feature commits. The first worker in a mission should create a separate setup commit for .factory/ infrastructure before the feature commit.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature add-context-menu-component committed 7 .factory/ infrastructure files alongside 3 feature files in commit 54e1eea, making the diff noisier and harder to review.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: The frontend-worker skill's verification step should emphasize that all four validators (grep for install, tsc --noEmit, eslint --fix, vitest run) must be run. Worker for add-context-menu-component skipped the eslint step.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature add-context-menu-component handoff verification.commandsRun has 3 entries (grep, tsc, vitest) but no eslint. The skill procedure lists eslint as a required verification step.

rejectedObservations.observation: Worker discovered a pre-existing flaky test (form.test.tsx 'should validate fields according to schema' times out at 500ms when run with full suite but passes in isolation)
rejectedObservations.reason: Pre-existing issue unrelated to this milestone. The test passes reliably (86 passed in our validation run). Documenting flaky tests in library/ would add noise for a non-reproducible issue.
